item.title: Davoren Park man wins $3.1 million after claiming a ‘genie’s kiss’ changed his luck
item.description: A Davoren Park resident hit a $3.1 million Keno jackpot, attributing this extraordinary luck to a mystical 'genie's kiss.'

item.title: FRINGE: Cosmic cabaret ‘Lassù’ makes a loud, wild and slightly unhinged debut at Adelaide Fringe
item.description: Circus cabaret Lassù is bringing high-risk stunts, cheeky comedy and cosmic chaos to Adelaide Fringe 2026 in a bold new show from the Infamous crew.

item.title: St Peters Fair comes alive at Linde Reserve for a day of free kids’ activities and family-friendly entertainment
item.description: St Peters Fair returns to Stepney next month, with live music, food trucks, and bucketloads of free activities for all ages.

item.title: The National Wine Centre’s ‘Drop In’ series returns with a celebration of alternative whites this March
item.description: The National Wine Centre’s Drop In tasting series returns this March with Alternative Whites, showcasing adventurous Australian varietals that are quietly redefining the white wine scene.

item.title: Got a pest of an ex? This Adelaide wildlife organisation is letting you feed them to a lizard this Valentine’s Day
item.description: Wilbur’s Wildlife is giving heartbroken (and cheeky) Adelaide locals the chance to name a feeder insect after their ex and watch it become lunch for a reptile.

item.title: “We forget to look up” Unique new boutique joins trend of openings sparking fresh energy in Adelaide Arcade
item.description: A Danish designer’s new boutique and a second creative retailer are bringing slow fashion, workshops and fresh energy into Adelaide Arcade’s historic spaces.

item.title: Epic cheese and pinot festival Mould x Pinot Palooza locks in Adelaide date for 2026
item.description: Mould x Pinot Palooza is heading to Adelaide for the first time, bringing unlimited cheese tastings, pinot pours and a nationwide lineup of producers to the city in 2026.

item.title: FIRST LOOK: Bar Pin is Adelaide inner west’s new fig-fuelled cocktail, wine, & small plates bar
item.description: A new art-forward small plates bar has opened in the west, pairing refined seasonal plates, local wines and unique cocktails with a leafy courtyard and late-night energy.

item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Saturday February 14th and the days ahead
item.description: Here's your Adelaide weather for Valentine's weekend. Spoiler alert: it's turning it on!

item.title: New $400M campus-style student housing to rise on landmark North Terrace corner
item.description: Plans unveiled for a $400m student accommodation complex on North Terrace, bringing hundreds of rooms, retail and a public plaza opposite Adelaide University.
